title: Kii ay ka reebtay Tijaabada Biyaha
intro: Qorniinka qadiimiga ah, waxaa jira qof xiiso leh oo sheekadiisu aysan ku bilaabmin mucjiso riwaayadeed ama muujin onkod leh, laakiin ay ku jirto tijaabo fudud oo qoto dheer oo iimaan ah. Ummad ayaa istaagtay isgoys, iyagoo raadinaya hagitaan rabbaani ah oo hoggaamineed. Waxa dhacay waxay ahayd imtixaan aad u caqli badan oo muujin kara rumaystayaasha dhabta ah ee iyaga ka mid ah. Ma ka furi kartaa qarsoodigan tilmaamaha laga tagay?
clues: Waxaan ka imid abtirsiin dadku ay qadariyaan, Allena wuxuu ii doortay ujeedo barakaysan oo aysan fahmi karin.
Jidhkaygu wuxuu lahaa calaamad muujinaysa kala duwanaansho ay dadka kale ka maqnaayeen, taasoo iga dhigaysa mid aan dadkayga ka dhex muuqan.
Markii wabiga lagu dhawaaqay in la tijaabiyay, badankood dib ayay u noqdeen—laakiin waan sii waday, anigoo ku kalsoon ballanqaadka Alle.
Waxaa la i faray inaanan waligay ka cabbin biyo xaaraan ah, haddana hal dhibic ayaa bushimahayga ka soo baxday - dembi qalbigayga ku dhibay weligiis.
Ilaahay wuxuu ii qaddaray inaan la kulmo adhijir dhallinyaro ah oo maalin uun noqon doona halyeey dil cadow weyn.
Markii ciidanku is-qabsadeen, gacanta cadowga kuma aanan dhicin, laakiin waxaan ku dhacay amar Ilaahi ah oo ciqaab u ah caasinimadaydii webiga.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
